description: Get a transcript with speakers and timestamps, up to 40 paragraphs (about 12k characters) per page. total is the paragraph count; pass next_offset as offset for the next page.

episode.description: Episode slug: episode_slug from list_episodes or a search result

limit.description: Most paragraphs per page, 1-80, default 40. A page also stops at about 12k characters of text.

offset.description: First paragraph to return, default 0. Use next_offset from the previous page, or a search_transcripts result's paragraph.

show.description: Show slug (such as huberman-lab) or show title (such as "Huberman Lab"), from list_shows or a search result's show_slug

name: get_transcript
title: Get transcript
